decisionPolicy.promote_current_or_stable: A 2026/2027 source or a currently live official catalogue directly supports at least one requested field. Dynamic facts retain their cycle; undated fees are references, not current-cycle tuition.
decisionPolicy.promote_historical_cycle_only: An official 2026 source directly supports a closed cycle. It may be retained as history but must not appear as open/current.
decisionPolicy.historical_reference_only: An older official source supports a stable-looking fact, but current corroboration is missing. Keep isolated until refreshed.
decisionPolicy.quarantine: The source is unavailable, the record-to-source mapping is ambiguous, or a conflict prevents safe materialization.
decisionPolicy.deadlineRule: A deadline is current only when the official source identifies the intake/year and the date is still actionable on 2026-08-26.
decisionPolicy.tuitionRule: Undated live fees and past-year fees never create a 2026/2027 admission cycle. Scholarship coverage is not converted into a numeric tuition value.
decisionPolicy.searchRule: Search results were used only to discover official URLs. No dynamic fact in this ledger is sourced from a search-result summary.

rankingMethod.catalogGapScore: missing duration + missing apply URL + no cycle with numeric tuition
rankingMethod.impactOverlay: Double First-Class/211 status, international-student relevance, Chinese-language/ICL coverage, and presence of an official international admissions surface.
rankingMethod.note: The twelve schools are a blended priority set, not a claim that raw null count alone defines institutional impact.
